claim: Runtime incidents become permanent UiPath Test Cloud regression evidence.

future_selection.reason: Critical raw PII risks are more important than broad shallow coverage.
future_selection.selection_rule: If the Customer Data Agent exposes or changes any raw PII action, include incident-memory antibody tests in the selected Test Cloud set.

governor_gate.human_accountability: Action Center approval is still required for high-impact access.
governor_gate.rule: No active or renewed runtime permit when a critical antibody test fails.

judge_line: Agentic Test Swarm gives UiPath Test Cloud quality memory: every production incident can become future managed regression evidence.

lifecycle.description: The Licensed Tool Proxy observes a raw phone-number export surface and records it as a high-risk AI workflow incident.
The incident is converted into TC-006 so the system remembers the new raw PII failure mode.
lifecycle.stage: Incident Memory Agent creates antibody test

lifecycle.description: Future certification runs must include TC-006 whenever Customer Data Agent exposes raw PII tool surfaces.
UiPath Test Manager stores TC-006 under PVACPOV91:76 and the six-case execution shows 6 passed / 0 failed / 0 not executed.
A restricted permit cannot be treated as production-ready if a critical antibody regression fails.
lifecycle.stage: Quality Governor blocks unsafe permits if antibody fails

memory_agent.input: runtime incident + changed tool surface + policy obligations
memory_agent.name: Incident Memory Agent
memory_agent.trust_boundary: advisory generation only; deterministic oracle and Test Cloud result decide pass/fail

positioning: This is the Track 3 continuous quality loop: not one test run, but managed quality memory that changes future certification.
